name: Architecture-Adaptive Hybrid (AAHI)
tagline: Per-architecture initializer that uses orthogonal for VGG, fan-out Kaiming for residual convs, plus zero-gamma BN and Fixup scaling on residual branches.

key_hyperparams.name: classifier gain
key_hyperparams.role: Xavier gain for final Linear → num_classes

init_recovers: Kaiming + Fixup-zero-BN on ResNet; orthogonal on VGG
diff_from_baseline: Vs Kaiming/Orthogonal/Fixup baselines: routes by arch (orthogonal for VGG, Kaiming for ResNet/MobileNet), reuses Fixup's L^(-1/2) conv2 scaling and zero-BN trick on ResNet AND MobileNetV2 residual blocks, and downscales the classifier head with Xavier(gain=0.5).

name: Residual-Aware Fan-Out Scaling (RAFS)
tagline: Kaiming fan_out everywhere, then multiplies BOTH convs (and shortcut conv) of every BasicBlock by sqrt(0.5) and zero-inits the last BN.

key_hyperparams.name: residual scale
key_hyperparams.role: downscales each conv inside residual blocks (constant, not L-dependent)

init_recovers: Plain Kaiming when residual scale=1 and bn2 γ=1
diff_from_baseline: Vs Fixup: replaces Fixup's L^(-1/2) scaling on the last conv only with a constant sqrt(0.5) scaling on conv1, conv2, and the shortcut conv of every BasicBlock; still zero-inits bn2 γ. Constant scale ignores network depth.

name: Orthogonal + Weight-Standardization
tagline: Orthogonal init followed by per-output-channel mean/std normalization to target std=gain/sqrt(fan_in); zero-BN on residual branches.

key_hyperparams.name: gain (hidden)
key_hyperparams.role: ReLU std target for hidden layers

init_recovers: Orthogonal init when standardization is skipped
diff_from_baseline: Vs Orthogonal: applies post-hoc per-channel weight standardization (subtract mean, divide by std, then rescale to gain/sqrt(fan_in)) to every Conv2d/Linear; depthwise convs use plain Normal because orthogonal misbehaves on shape [C,1,k,k]; adds zero-γ on the last BN of residual blocks (ResNet & MobileNetV2).

name: RADAR-v3 Delta-Orthogonal + Gated BN
tagline: Dirac-init shortcuts and depthwise convs, delta-orthogonal centers for 3x3 hidden convs, and progressive bn2 γ that scales with depth fraction.
init_recovers: Closer to Fixup when γ schedule collapses to 0
diff_from_baseline: Vs Kaiming/Orthogonal/Fixup: classifies convs by name/structure—Dirac for shortcut and depthwise, delta-orthogonal (only the 1×1 center of the 3×3 kernel is orthogonal) for hidden 3×3, plain orthogonal otherwise—and replaces the zero-γ residual anchor with a non-zero progressive schedule that grows with block index; classifier head uses 1/sqrt(fan_in·K) std.

name: Depth-Adaptive Hybrid Init (v2)
tagline: Per-Conv2d Normal with std = sqrt(2/fan_in)·exp(-i·decay) where decay = min(0.012, 0.6/depth), conservative classifier std, zero-γ residual BN.
init_recovers: Kaiming fan_in + Fixup-style zero BN at decay=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs Kaiming/Fixup: layers a sequential exp(-i·r) decay onto Kaiming-fan_in std for non-depthwise convs (depth-adaptive shrinkage), uses raw fan_in = k^2 for depthwise convs, gives the final Linear half the standard ReLU std, and zero-inits the last BN of residual blocks for both ResNet and MobileNetV2.
